framework.note: Governs QIPs for listed companies; permits deemed-approval equity issuance to qualified institutional buyers without shareholder resolution.

headline: Sterlite Technologies Limited: Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) of Equity Shares
sum: Sterlite Technologies announced a qualified institutions placement (QIP) of equity shares, each of face value ₹2, under SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 and Companies Act 2013 Section 42.
detail: Sterlite Technologies, a listed telecom-infrastructure and speciality optical-fibre player, initiated a QIP under the SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 Chapter VI framework and Companies Act 2013 Section 42. QIPs permit listed companies to issue fresh equity to 'qualified institutional buyers' (mutual funds, insurance companies, provident funds, foreign portfolio investors, banks) without prior shareholder approval, subject to board/audit committee sign-off and pricing at a floor determined by a regulatory formula. The exchange intimation, dated 24 Jun 2026, signalled the placement opening; the specific quantum and issue price were not disclosed in this intimation.
